evidence.title: Introducing Exciting New Tools from Ceros: Farewell to Open Design

name: Open Design
summary: Sunset notice: Open Design was retired on October 1, 2023, and the page now points to Ceros Studio and MarkUp.
description: "Open Design" was sunset on October 1st, 2023 and is no longer in service. The site keeps a farewell page from Ceros introducing two successor tools: Studio, for designing and publishing interactive digital experiences, and MarkUp, for collecting feedback on websites, videos, images and design files.
contains: Open Design was sunset on October 1, 2023
successor tools: Ceros Studio (interactive experiences) and MarkUp (feedback)
